tha-ap304:1.1: Sabbagandhiya.] Gandhamālaṃ mayā dinnaṃ Vipassissa mahesino / adāsim ujubhūtassa koseyyaṃ vattham uttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap304:2.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ vattham adadiṃ pure / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi *gandhadānass'* idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap304:3.1: Ito pannarase kappe Sucelo nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap304:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sabbagandhiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
